title: Concept: Apache .htaccess file served as a response
description: An .htaccess file discloses the routing table, the enabled modules and the protected paths, and it confirms that the server will honour an uploaded file of the same name. It is the map an attacker reads before trying anything else.
applicability: Responses from Apache hosts that serve dotfiles or from a proxy that forwards them.
risk: The caller learns which paths exist and which protections are configured, and can plan around them rather than probe blindly.
